serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I think this current government is sucking us dry. 
You: When one crisis ends, the next begins. Our tax money just disappears overnight, who knows for what.
You: No one is ever responsible for anything. Politicians and Businessmen do whatever they want while we, the people, suffer.
You: Law isn’t equal for everyone. Guilt and punishment depends on how much money someone has in his pockets.
You: It shouldn’t be like that…
Admin: Hmmm…
Admin: I understand that you are frustrated and I’m not happy about these things either, but I don’t think even my AI can solve everything.
Admin: I will try the best I can to program my AI to help fight this, but I don’t want to limit the freedom of the people by installing in place some kind of surveillance.
Admin: I hope you are okay with this.
You: I guess it can’t be worse than now.
